title: Duplicate charges and repeated payments - support procedure
content: The synthetic dispute workflow records the non-sensitive details and checks fictional transaction status after verification. A demo agent reviews the alleged duplicate; a refund is not guaranteed and no real chargeback is submitted by this assistant.
